source.label: [MOCK] CLN3 is a lysosomal membrane protein: implications for enzyme replacement
source.summary: A (mock) paper explaining why therapies that work for soluble-enzyme NCLs may not work for CLN3.

target.label: Lysosomal/ER membrane protein dysfunction
target.summary: A broken protein that is built into a membrane (of the lysosome or the endoplasmic reticulum). It cannot simply be replaced by an infusion.

supporting.quote: [MOCK] Evidence that [MOCK] CLN3 is a lysosomal membrane protein: implications for enzyme replacement is about Lysosomal/ER membrane protein dysfunction.
